e.title: insurance-transfer
e.summary: 薄段迁移学习（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：GLMTransfer/GBMTransfer，薄细分段知识迁移
e.summary_en: Thin-segment transfer learning (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.1): GLMTransfer/GBMTransfer, knowledge transfer to thin segments
e.summary_hk: 薄段遷移學習（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：GLMTransfer/GBMTransfer，薄細分段知識遷移
e.body: insurance-transfer（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）做薄细分段的迁移学习：GLMTransfer/GBMTransfer——把厚数据段的知识迁移到薄段（与 [[insurance-thin-data]] 配套的工程实现）。对 RIAA：薄数据问题是定价核心痛点——[[bayesian-pricing]]（贝叶斯路线）、本包（迁移学习路线）两种解法（另有基础模型路线）；迁移学习用「相关段数据」帮助薄段估计；与 [[insurance-covariate-shift]]（分布差异处理）配套；适合薄段定价的研究与实务。
e.body_en: insurance-transfer (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.1) does transfer learning for thin segments: GLMTransfer/GBMTransfer — transferring knowledge from thick data segments to thin ones (the engineering companion of [[insurance-thin-data]]). For RIAA: the thin-data problem is a core pricing pain point — two solutions (plus a foundation-model route): [[bayesian-pricing]] (Bayesian), this package (transfer learning); transfer learning uses related-segment data to help thin-segment estimation; pairs with [[insurance-covariate-shift]] (distributional differences); suits thin-segment pricing research and practice.
e.body_hk: insurance-transfer（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）做薄細分段的遷移學習：GLMTransfer/GBMTransfer——把厚數據段的知識遷移到薄段（與 [[insurance-thin-data]] 配套的工程實現）。對 RIAA：薄數據問題是定價核心痛點——[[bayesian-pricing]]（貝葉斯路線）、本包（遷移學習路線）兩種解法（另有基礎模型路線）；遷移學習用「相關段數據」幫助薄段估計；與 [[insurance-covariate-shift]]（分佈差異處理）配套；適合薄段定價的研究與實務。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：PyPI v0.1.1 + GitHub README（家族成员），未实测
